source_row.wylie: bsam pa la gsum las, 'du shes ni bzhi ste, gzhi sems can lta bu la sems can du 'du shes pa dang sems can min par 'du shes pa dang sems can min pa la sems can min par 'du shes pa dang sems can du 'du shes pa bzhi ste, 'du shes dang po dang gsum pa ni ma 'khrul ba dang , gnyis pa dang bzhi pa ni 'khrul ba'o,
source_row.english: The part of the thinking has three components of its own. Conception can be of four different types: to conceive of the object, say a living being, as being a living being; to conceive of a living being as something other than a living being; to conceive of something other than a living being as being other than a living being, and to conceive of this same thing as a living being. The first and third types of conception here are unmistaken; the second and fourth are mistaken.

spans.rationale: The opening technical category is thinking; it has three components, of which conception is discussed here.
The cardinal counts the components of thinking. Part, components and of its own are English organizational support.
The initial conception noun begins the four-case subdivision, preserving the printed capital.
The first cardinal counts the four conceptions; the repeated recap BZHI later has no second English four.
This noun introduces the object in the first conception case, not a separate object in all four repetitions.
The first explicit sentient-being noun is the illustrative object after say.
The complete exemplifying expression supplies say in the sense for example. This is an illustrative construction, not a literal saying verb or a quotation.
The second source noun is the first-case predicate: a living being conceived as a living being.
The complete predicative case particle has direct as being evidence and introduces the first-case identification.
First full conception verb owns first conceive; infinitival to and argument of stay outside.

spans.eng: something other than a living being
spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: as something other than a living being;
spans.rationale: The complete negative-predicative construction is rendered as something other than a living being in the second case. Whole negative phrase avoids assigning the relational other than to an isolated nonexistent other noun; MIN PAR remains intact. The repeated English object before as has no new separate source noun.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: to conceive of a living being as something
spans.rationale: Second full conception verb owns the second conceive, whose living object is resumed from the first case.

spans.eng: something other than a living being
spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: to conceive of something other than a living being as being
spans.rationale: The third-case object is explicitly a non-living-being object. Keep its complete negative nominal phrase with the matching whole English object.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: as being other than a living being,
spans.rationale: The third-case negative predicate again identifies that object as not a living being. The whole inflected predicate maps the complete other-than phrase; preceding as being is distributed case/copular support, not a separate source atom here.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: to conceive of something other than a living being as being
spans.rationale: Third full conception verb owns the third conceive.
This third serial DANG has the explicit English and introducing case four. Earlier list DANGs are not copied onto this one occurrence.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: this same thing as a living being.
spans.rationale: The last case predicates living being of that same non-being object. This is the final living-being occurrence in the enumeration.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: this same thing as a living being.
spans.rationale: The final predicative DU supplies as in case four; unlike case one there is no separately printed being auxiliary in this frame.

spans.complete_local_clause_anchor: to conceive of this same thing
spans.rationale: Fourth full conception verb owns the fourth conceive; this same thing is an English anaphoric restatement.
This final conception noun is shared in the classification of the first/third and second/fourth cases.
First ordinal identifies the correct positive recognition.
This DANG joins first and third, distinct from the list and before case four.
Third ordinal identifies correct negative recognition.
The whole established negative adjective directly attests unmistaken. MA is not split into an English subword or a false null.
Second ordinal identifies mistaken negative recognition.
This last DANG joins second and fourth, not the previous two ordinals.
Fourth ordinal identifies mistaken positive recognition.
The complete final inflected adjective retains its bound sentence ending. Base KHRUL BA directly supports mistaken; no separate apostrophe-O span or English subword is invented.

omissions.tib: la and las in the opening; ni; ste; la after lta bu; first two serial dang; third-case object la; recap bzhi ste; dang after ma khrul ba
omissions.reason: Organizational, topical, predicative and serial grammar is distributed through English has/components/types, argument prepositions, punctuation and the shared classification. The second source BZHI recaps four without a second English numeral; uncertainty about that recap is not lexical absence. Do not multiply four or reuse the explicit final-list and.

omissions.english: The part of the; has; components of its own; can be of; different types; to; of; the; a; second-case a living being before as; as being before the third negative predicate; this same thing; types of; here are; the; are
omissions.reason: Nominal framing, infinitival and article support, anaphoric repetitions and shared copulas remain unwrapped. The second-case object and fourth-case this same thing resume prior objects without new source tokens, while the explicit negative predicate phrases retain their own source occurrences.
